+    @staticmethod
+    def normalize_history(history: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
+        """
+        把市场索引的更新记录归一化为版本到文本的映射。
+
+        第三方索引可能把版本说明写成含 ``content`` 的嵌套对象，这里取其正文拼接为文本，
+        无法得到正文的条目直接丢弃，避免错误类型进入响应模型。
+
+        :param history: 索引中的原始 history 字段
+        :return: 仅包含字符串值的更新记录
+        """
+        if not isinstance(history, dict):
+            return {}
+        normalized: dict[str, str] = {}
+        for version, note in history.items():
+            if isinstance(note, dict):
+                note = note.get("content")
+                if isinstance(note, list):
+                    note = "\n".join(str(item) for item in note)
+            if isinstance(note, str):
+                normalized[str(version)] = note
+        return normalized

+def test_nested_history_is_normalized_to_text() -> None:
+    """
+    第三方索引把 history 值写成嵌套对象时，应归一化为字符串且不触发序列化警告。
+    """
+    info = {
+        "name": "Demo",
+        "version": "1.7.3",
+        "history": {
+            "v1.7.3": {"version": "1.7.3", "date": "2026-01-01", "content": ["修复A", "修复B"]},
+            "v1.18.4": {"version": "1.18.4"},
+            "v1.0.0": "初始版本",
+        },
+    }
+    plugin = _mapper().map("Demo", info, REPO, [], 0, "v3")
+    assert plugin is not None
+    assert plugin.history == {"v1.7.3": "修复A\n修复B", "v1.0.0": "初始版本"}
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("error")
+        plugin.model_dump_json()
